singular_truth: The plan is a plain markdown file on disk, not context. So when the session is wiped (/clear, a crash), the plan is still there and the agent reads it back and continues exactly where it left off.
money_thing: A hard context wipe blanks everything, then the plan re-materializes from disk intact and the work resumes. Memory that a wipe can't erase.
logline: Your agent's working memory, written to disk, so nothing you can throw at it makes it forget the plan.
rejected_default: The obvious treatment for an agent-tooling project is a node-diagram of the hook flow plus a terminal typing the install command, flash between, wordmark bookends. Rejected: it buries the ONE cool thing (the plan surviving a wipe) inside plumbing, and it is exactly the shape the last several videos used. The singular truth here is emotional (persistence through erasure), not architectural, so it wants a metaphor and a before/after transform, not a wiring diagram.
references: a save icon that outlives a power cut
colorist amber-phosphor logs (the light that stays on)
the match-cut in 2001 as a transform that carries an idea across a hard boundary
